# Waveshare e-Paper Display Driver

This directory contains the minimal Waveshare display driver files required to
compile Pocket Scout:

```text
epaper_driver_bsp.h
epaper_driver_bsp.cpp
```

Source repository:

```text
https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-S3-ePaper-1.54
```

Original source path:

```text
02_Example/Arduino/10_LVGL_V9_Test/src/display/
```

The files are copied unchanged from the Waveshare example code. No license notice
was found in these files at the time of import. They are third-party Waveshare
code and are not covered by the Pocket Scout MIT license.
